elastic_tensor.ieee_format is a finite 6-by-6 GPa tensor
fitting_data has exactly 24 total strain-stress states and non-empty optimization and deformation task provenance
structure composition equals elemental_composition after gcd reduction
the standardized structure has the registered space group, exact AFLOW prototype/Wyckoff signature, and no partial occupancies
the same locked standardized structure supplies both candidate geometry and reference values; formula-only or nearest-polymorph matching is forbidden

elastic_convention.model_measurement_requirement: fully relaxed equilibrium cell plus internal-coordinate relaxation at every symmetric finite strain, converted to the same IEEE convention

selection_algorithm: Parse the source-pool lock as UTF-8 JSON and reject duplicate candidate_id or source_structure_id values.
Validate every Materials Project record and reference against materials_project_reference_contract before it can be eligible.
Derive all four grouping keys with the hash-locked grouping executable and vocabulary; supplied chemistry or composition-neighbourhood labels are forbidden.
Remove candidates whose source_structure_id occurs in any excluded prior panel; no fuzzy identity substitution is allowed.
For each candidate compute rank = lowercase_hex(SHA256(seed + U+0000 + class + U+0000 + source_structure_id)).
Within each class sort by (rank, source_structure_id), both ascending bytewise UTF-8, and select exactly the class quota.

Before emission verify every selected structure has at least four other selected structures in its class with accepted references for every confirmatory property and verify at least 16 class-calibration-eligible distinct structures per class and property without reading model outputs; otherwise STRUCTURALLY_UNDERPOWERED_REFUSE.

Do not require chemistry, prototype, neighbourhood, or legacy exact-tuple groups to be powered; their insufficiency is a prospectively registered empirical refusal state, not a reason to substitute labels or alter the panel.
Concatenate ionics-rocksalt then perovskites, assign panel_index 0 through 124, and emit canonical JSON sorted by panel_index.
The output must contain exactly 63 ionics-rocksalt plus 62 perovskite structures and exactly 125 unique candidate_id and source_structure_id values.
hull_and_license_algorithm: For held-out structure X, registered model m, property p, and one named calibration rule, select every other panel structure whose derived key for that rule equals X's key and whose reference for p is accepted; X is always excluded.
Require at least four calibration structures; otherwise emit INSUFFICIENT_GROUP_CALIBRATION for that rule/model/structure/property.
Convert each predicted/reference ratio to integer U=10000 by decimal round-half-even; set lo=min, hi=max, and b=median with even median rounded decimal half-even.
Record hull_width = hi-lo in fixed-point units and normalized_hull_width = (hi-lo)/U without binary floating-point recomputation.
Direction gate: continue only when every ratio is strictly above U or every ratio is strictly below U; mixed-side or equality to U emits DIRECTION_GATE_ABSTAIN.
Inflation sharp license holds exactly when U<lo and b*(2*U-lo) < lo*U; deflation sharp license holds exactly when hi<U and hi*(U+b) < 2*U*b; equality refuses strict improvement.
Record SHARP_LICENSED or SHARP_LICENSE_ABSTAIN separately for every rule; never copy a hull or disposition across rules.
Apply the correction only for the v3 primary class rule. Secondary-rule license states answer grouping admissibility but never generate substituted corrected predictions or confirmatory wins.
Compute the immutable v2 exact-tuple diagnostic with equality on all four derived keys and the same arithmetic; never relabel it as the v3 class endpoint.

analysis_requirements.secondary_width_contrasts: chemistry/prototype/neighbourhood versus class, paired within structure and model then median across exactly four models; one-sided exact sign test for narrower alternative; 18 class-by-elastic-property-by-alternative-rule tests with Holm FWER 0.1
